def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric (handle comma separators)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Set out-of-range body_mass_g to NaN (rules: 2500–6500)
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # Fix sex label variant (FEMALE -> female)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df.loc[~df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']), 'sex'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    result = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g']).groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in result.items()}
